sources.version_scope: Current manual, applied to installed three 0.186.x resource lifecycle with source inspection
sources.verified_fact: Obsolete geometries/materials/textures require explicit disposal; scene removal does not dispose them. Shared resources require ownership-aware cleanup. Reusing a disposed material can regenerate GPU resources and incur a performance cost.
sources.application_inference: Pet3DModels module-global materials are shared across concurrent canvas scenes, so per-canvas unconditional disposal can cause recompilation in other scenes. Use owned clones or explicit shared lifetime management.
sources.limitations: Source review plus targeted tests does not measure actual GPU memory on every device. Earlier /manual/en/... links returned404; only the successfully retrieved /manual/pages/... source is relied on.

sources.verified_fact: Font resources can be selectively downloaded for the text covered by Unicode ranges.
sources.application_inference: 22.27MB total complete localfont coverage is not the initial page transfer. Measure actual route font requests and preserve fallback coverage rather than removing arbitrary Hanzi glyphs.

sources.verified_fact: Speech synthesis uses browser/platform utterance queues and exposes errors; enqueueing is not proof of audible successful playback or pronunciation quality.
sources.application_inference: Exam control must surface unavailable Mandarin voice and asynchronous synthesis errors while leaving answer/timer/checkpoint state unchanged. Tests cannot certify native pronunciation or physical speaker output.
